mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior 3 months indicates monetary easing, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% indicates a tight monetary policy that increases discount rates for equity valuation, suppressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the prior 3 months signals improving labor market conditions, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in periods of declining UNRATE are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Jointly elevated housing starts (HOUST) and real sales of automobiles and furniture (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages indicate robust consumer demand, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are above 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high industrial production growth rate (INDPRO) above 0.5% over the prior 3 months indicates strong economic output, which in the late-cycle expansion regime accelerates corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO growth rate > 0.5% in 3 months during late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPIAUCSL inflation rate above 3.0% indicates rising price pressures that may trigger monetary tightening, suppressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP growth (GDPC1) over the prior 3 months indicates expanding economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods of rising GDPC1 are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Jointly strong payroll growth (PAYEMS) and low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) indicate a favorable monetary environment for labor market expansion, which accelerates corporate hiring and earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 0.3% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
